title: One Speed Budget for Base and Arm: What a Person's Nearness Allows, What the Load Allows, and a Supervisor That Shares the Smaller Between Them

artifact.note: a supervisor for the speeds of a base with an arm: the fastest the base may go so that it can stop in a given distance by braking at a fraction of the deceleration at which it would tip (33-05); the speed that a person's nearness allows for the whole robot (31-06), which is the sum of the base's speed toward them and the hand's; a sharing of that budget between base and hand when both are asked for more than it (both scaled by the same factor); and a supervisor step that gives the limited speeds, a status (free, scaled, stopped) and which limit was binding, tested against a person walking at the robot
